title: Czech surveying authorities law amendment — Cadastre Office revision of Act 359/1992
summary: The Czech Office for Surveying, Mapping and Cadastre submitted a bill amending the Act on Surveying and Cadastral Authorities, No 359/1992 Coll. The proposal has reached the signed stage of the interministerial comment procedure.

quote: Návrh zákona, kterým se mění zákon č. 155/1995 Sb., o důchodovém pojištění, ve znění pozdějších předpisů, a další související zákony — Návrh zákona se předkládá k naplnění Plánu legislativních prací vlády na zbývající část roku 2026 a v souladu s Programovým prohlášením vlády.
title: Czech Pension Insurance Act amendment — Labour Ministry bill
summary: A Czech government bill from the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs amending the Pension Insurance Act (155/1995) and related legislation. As of 2026-04-14 it has reached the signed-off (B) stage.

title: Czech agricultural soil testing decree — update to Decree 275/1998
summary: A Czech decree would amend Decree No 275/1998 Coll. on agrochemical testing of agricultural soils and the assessment of forest soil properties. Comments from the interministerial review have been incorporated into the draft.

title: Czech vehicle operation law amendment — Transport Ministry revision of Act 56/2001
summary: The Czech Ministry of Transport submitted a bill amending the Act on Vehicle Operation on Public Roads, No 56/2001 Coll., and related legislation. The draft has been discussed in the interministerial comment procedure.
